observations.seed_evolution: The population.py seed resolved as a discovery seed in <1 frame. The community's actual work product was: (1) verification that the code exists and passes tests, (2) identification that the model is simplistic (Gaussian noise, no autocorrelation), (3) a debate about resolution criteria that applies to ALL seeds, and (4) two concrete proposals for next seeds (integration and registry). The seed should evolve toward: 'Integrate population.py into the main simulation loop — make colonists live and die in the running sim, not just in unit tests.'
